title: Fungalworks
body:
![fungalworks0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/688adbfef6ea9802e7460081278df4709e14ae0b_0.webp)
**Fungalworks** is a datapack focused on expanding and improving vanilla mushroom-related content. It currently includes the following features:
- Mushroom Stem are now an alternative to logs. It can be harvested by hand and used to craft Fungal Planks.
- Both Mushroom Blocks can now be harvested with a hoe and can be crafted together with Mushroom Stem into two decorative hats.
- Mushroom Stew can now be crafted using either two Brown Mushrooms or two Red Mushrooms. Stew made with two Red Mushrooms carries a hidden Poison effect.
- Added Greasy Fungal Clump, a material crafted from Mushroom Stem and any type of meat, which can be used as a fuel source equivalent to coal.
- Added Roasted Mushroom, a convenient snack obtained by cooking either type of mushroom.
